name: used-alternative-alert
description: Browser extension to give you second hand/used alternatives to new products when shopping.

scripts.build: npm run build-manifest && rollup --config && cp ./lib/popup.* ./dist-unpackaged/chrome/ && cp -r ./lib/img/ ./dist-unpackaged/chrome/img/ && cp ./lib/popup.* ./dist-unpackaged/firefox/ && cp -r ./lib/img/ ./dist-unpackaged/firefox/img/
scripts.package: npm run purge-zip && npm run zip-chrome && npm run zip-firefox

author: Espen Klem
